== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Decipher-era [[Luke Skywalker]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published face; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous filled cell. Virtual Modern [[Luke Skywalker (V)]] is a later wave. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
